description: This is a shell script used for testing Git repository operations, specifically focusing on disabling local paths in clone/fetch commands. It sets up repositories, tests behavior with dash-prefixed repo names, and verifies path handling.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Sets up protocol-related testing for repository URLs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing script.
